## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmed by sector breadth strength and neutral risk ratios (VXX NEUTRAL / SPY_TLT NEUTRAL). Tech weakness (XLK (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -7.13%) BELOW TREND) offsets strength in Financials (XLF (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -7.70%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -0.54%) BELOW TREND → overall neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: U.S. rates moving tighter as TLT (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, dollar signals neutral per barometer → financial conditions neither easing nor loosening decisively.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Financials leading: XLF (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare strong: XLV (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. Tech showing weakness: XLK (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -7.13%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -0.98%) RECOVERY vs Emerging Markets weakness: EEM (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -4.40%) BELOW TREND; China FXI (1W: +2.46% | 1M: -7.71%) RECOVERY but fragile.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present: IBIT (1W: +5.76% | 1M: +0.36%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +22.94%) ABOVE TREND; small caps mixed with IWM (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +1.67%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals recovering: GLD (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -18.69%) RECOVERY; base metals and copper soft with CPER (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.89%) RECOVERY → mixed.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy recovering on a weak base: XLE (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -6.33%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +2.64% | 1M: -20.10%) RECOVERY, but 1M weakness still signals vulnerability; UNG (1W: +2.89% | 1M: -2.97%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare XLV (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals across small/mid caps and sector ETFs (IJT, IWM, XLU) — MINOR divergence overall but monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Financials and Healthcare exposure; reduce exposure to Technology (XLK (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -7.13%) BELOW TREND) and lagging EM (EEM (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -4.40%) BELOW TREND); bonds neutral given TLT (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLF (1W: +4.34% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +22.94%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -7.13%) BELOW TREND, EEM (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -4.40%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +3.59%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -18.69%) RECOVERY, UNG (1W: +2.89% | 1M: -2.97%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: XME (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -20.30%) BELOW TREND, URA (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -16.96%) BELOW TREND, TAN (1W: -4.84% | 1M: -22.19%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health watch), XLK/XLF pivot ~1.0 (growth vs value rotation).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, offset by neutral risk ratios and mixed rate signals. Financials and Healthcare showing strength while Tech weakness and small‑cap corrections are the primary divergence to monitor.
